name: Attendance Custom Search Restriction
description: Attendance search restriction provides administrators with flexible control over advanced search features in the Attendance module. The access right can be configured directly from individual user settings to decide whether advanced search options are available. When Attendance Advanced Search is set to No, the user cannot create custom filters or custom grouping in Attendance views. When the access right is enabled, users can create custom filters, apply domains, and use grouping options according to their requirements. This approach helps administrators control advanced search capabilities while keeping standard Attendance access rights unchanged.
summary: Attendance search restriction helps administrators manage advanced search permissions in the Attendance module with ease. It provides a dedicated access right to control whether individual users can access advanced search functionality. When Attendance Advanced Search is disabled, users cannot create custom filters, custom domains, or custom grouping options in Attendance views. When the permission is enabled, authorized users can use custom filters and grouping features for more flexible data analysis. This app offers user-specific control without changing standard Attendance access rights or workflows. Administrators can configure the permission directly from the user settings for simple and effective access management. Improve Attendance security, simplify user permissions, and maintain better control over advanced search operations with this flexible access restriction solution.

name: Crm Lead Archive Restriction
description: CRM Lead Archive Restriction provides a simple way to control the visibility of the Archive and Unarchive options for CRM Lead and Opportunity records. Administrators can decide whether users are allowed to archive or unarchive records from the CRM Pipeline. When archive/unarchive access is allowed, the Archive and Unarchive buttons remain visible to users. When the access is set to No, these buttons are hidden from the CRM Lead and Opportunity interface. This helps administrators restrict archive and unarchive actions while keeping other CRM functionalities unchanged.
summary: CRM Lead Archive Restriction helps administrators control Archive and Unarchive options for CRM Lead and Opportunity records. name: CRM Lead View Type Restriction
description:
CRM View Type Restriction allows administrators to control the availability of the View Type option in the CRM Lead interface for individual users.

When the restriction is enabled for a user, the View Type option is removed from the CRM Lead view, preventing the user from changing or selecting different view types from that interface. This provides a simple way to control the CRM Lead interface based on user requirements.

The module works independently of the user's existing CRM access rights and standard Odoo security permissions.
summary: CRM View Type Restriction provides a simple and effective way to control the View Type option in the CRM Lead interface of Odoo. It allows administrators to manage the visibility of the View Type option for individual users. When the restriction is enabled, the View Type option is removed from the CRM Lead interface for the selected user. This prevents users from changing or selecting different view types from the CRM Lead screen. Administrators can configure this restriction according to user roles and business requirements. The module works independently of existing CRM access rights and standard Odoo security permissions. It helps maintain a cleaner and more controlled CRM interface for users. name: Duplicate Restriction Base
description: Duplicate Restriction Base provides the core functionality for controlling Duplicate actions across Odoo records. It retrieves user-specific duplicate restriction settings and applies them to supported Form and List views. When duplicate access is restricted, the Duplicate action is automatically removed from the available action menu. The base module provides a reusable restriction mechanism that can be extended by other duplicate restriction applications. It helps administrators maintain consistent control over record duplication while keeping standard Odoo workflows unchanged.
summary: Duplicate Restriction Base is a core Odoo module designed to provide a reusable framework for controlling Duplicate actions. When duplicate access is restricted for a user, the Duplicate option is removed from the available action menu. The module provides common functionality that can be shared by multiple record-specific Duplicate Restriction applications.
